extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions (max 45 characters).

extDescription.message: Highlight text and pin sticky notes on any web page. Everything stays on your device.

commandNewNote.message: Add a sticky note to this page
commandNewNote.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

contextHighlight.description: Context menu item shown when text is selected.

toolbarLabel.description: Accessible name of the floating toolbar that appears on text selection.

toastSelectText.message: Select some text on the page first.

toastPaused.message: QuickNotes is paused on this site.

toastOrphans.message: Highlights not found on this page: $COUNT$. The side panel lists them.

toastSaveFailed.message: Your change could not be saved. Storage may be full.

popupPausedHint.message: No toolbar, highlights or notes on $SITE$ while paused.

popupUnsupported.message: QuickNotes can't run on this page. Open a regular website to take notes.

popupShortcutHint.message: Tip: select text to highlight it, or press $SHORTCUT$ for a new note.

popupError.message: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.

sidePanelNoPage.message: Open a web page and click the QuickNotes button to see its notes here.

sidePanelEmpty.message: No highlights or notes on this page yet. Select some text to start.

optionsShowToolbar.message: Show the toolbar when I select text

optionsShortcut.message: Keyboard shortcut for a new note

optionsAutoRestore.message: Restore my notes automatically on every site

optionsAutoRestoreHelp.message: Off by default. When on, Chrome asks for permission to read and change data on all sites so highlights and notes can reappear as soon as a page loads. Nothing ever leaves your device.

optionsAutoRestoreDenied.message: Permission was not granted, so automatic restore stays off.

optionsInvalidSite.message: Enter a site such as example.com.

optionsDangerHelp.message: Deletes every highlight and note on every page, and resets these options. Type $WORD$ to confirm.
